stem: How can the reader tell that this is a free verse poem?

options.label: A
options.text: There are words that describe sights and sounds.

options.label: B
options.text: The lines of the poem do not rhyme with one another.

options.label: C
options.text: The speaker uses the word "I" to describe himself.

options.label: D
options.text: The pants are able to talk to the speaker.
